import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int).fillna({"avg_check": 0})
X_development, X_final, y_development, y_final = train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
X_train, X_validation, y_train, y_validation = train_test_split(X_development,y_development,test_size=.25,random_state=43,stratify=y_development)


rows=[]
for a in [.0001,.1,1.,10.]:
    model=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(32,),alpha=a,max_iter=500,random_state=0)).fit(X_train,y_train)
    rows.append({"alpha":a,"train":round(roc_auc_score(y_train,model.predict_proba(X_train)[:,1]),3),"validation":round(roc_auc_score(y_validation,model.predict_proba(X_validation)[:,1]),3)})
res=pd.DataFrame(rows)
best_alpha=float(res.sort_values(["validation","alpha"],ascending=[False,True]).iloc[0]["alpha"])
gap_small=round(rows[0]["train"]-rows[0]["validation"],3);gap_big=round(rows[-1]["train"]-rows[-1]["validation"],3)
